about: How the Crimson 2 specimens in this folder are installed (tools/convert_crimson2.py --recipe this-file --area NAME). Owner decisions of 2026-10-28: Moria34 is Crimson's edition of stock zone 41 (25 of 26 rooms identical), so only its new mobiles/objects and the resets that load them are merged into zone 41; Shatterstone becomes zone 58, linked from the Dwarven Kingdom.

Moria34.notes: 4108 Melcrin, sovereign of the trolls (new; keeps 4108). 4104 the phantom becomes 4109 because stock 4104 is the orc. 4105 Blade of the moors trolls (new; keeps 4105). Resets use zone 41's own rooms 4106, 4113 and 4115, as in Crimson's zone file. Melcrin, the phantom and the Blade are rescaled to the zone (owner decision 2026-10-28); see overrides.

4108.reason: zone 41 boss (stock levels 6-13): was level 48, 35d10+24000 hp, 20d20+50 damage, AC -35, 1.5M exp, aggressive to all, sanctuary; now a level-16 sentinel caster modelled on stock level-16 mobs (3d3+160 hp, 2d2+2, thac0 15) plus a boss margin

4104.reason: was level 18 with ~300 hp, 4d5+15 damage, AC +26 and aggressive to all; now a level-11 wandering undead like stock level-11 mobs (2d2+110, thac0 17, AC 3), scavenger/stay-zone/wimpy kept, not aggressive

4105.reason: boss drop for a level-16 boss: was 11d5 slash +4 damroll, level 41, cost 40000; now 3d5 slash +2 damroll, level 15, in line with stock level 10-20 weapons (2d9..6d3, cost 300-1500)

Shatterstone.name: Shatterstone (Crimson 2, unfinished)

5830.reason: unfinished-template torch carried +100 hitroll and +145 damroll and could not be picked up as 'torch'; now the stock torch (obj 3030): take+hold, 24 hours of light, cost 10

5830.short: the spirit of a dwarven guard
5830.long: The spirit of a dwarven guard stands watch here, still bearing its death wounds.
5830.description: This is the spirit of a dwarven guard, still showing the wounds that killed his body.
5830.reason: unfinished template (keywords 'blank', level 48, 1d1+1 hp, 99d99-25 damage, AC -40, 2M exp, aggressive to all); now a non-aggressive level-20 sentinel like stock level-20 guards (4d4+200, 3d3+3, thac0 14), texts from the source description; Str 25 from the template lowered to 18 like stock guard-class mobs

links.description: A narrow crack in the cavern roof leads up into a sooty mineshaft.

exits.description: A broad stairway leads down into the city below.
exits.reason: the source exit text was garbled ('steps going down.Steps going down', keywords 'steps going down.'); replaced with a description matching room 5831 (a large stairway down into the city, whose up exit returns 'To the overlook.'); no door, so no keywords, like every other exit in the zone

Shatterstone.notes: Mob 5831 'the Blank Mob' is an empty template with no content to be faithful to, so it is excluded. The source zone has no resets; the recipe adds them (fix of 2026-10-28, the guard and torch otherwise never load): room 5832 sees 'a massive gate guarded by two dwarven guards' and in 5833 'Before the gates' the guards turn out to be spirits, so two guard spirits 5830 (max 2) stand in 5833, each holding the torch 5830 in its light slot (wear position 0, WEAR_LIGHT; max 2), since the torch is a take+hold light with no other wear flag. Lifespan 20 and reset mode 2 like the Dwarven Kingdom (zone 65) it is linked from; the source header's 1 0 would never reload a killed guard.
